title: Effects of coenzyme Q10 supplementation on myopathy in statin-treated patients: a systematic review and meta-analysis
authors: Kovacic S, Habicht SD, Eckert GP
population: Seven randomised trials of CoQ10 (100 to 600 mg/day) against control in adults taking statins with muscle pain as an outcome
funder: Financial support was provided by the Society for Applied Vitamin Research (GVF, Jena, Germany).
authorConflicts: The authors declare no conflict of interest.
result: Four of seven trials showed a significant reduction of statin-associated muscle symptoms and three no significant change; pooled weighted mean difference in pain intensity -0.96 (95% CI -1.88 to -0.03). The authors state that more research is needed for evidence-based recommendations. The membership and funding of the Society for Applied Vitamin Research are not stated in the paper.
